intro.text: A spren whom Syl finds a bore, with a very mathematical mind.

items.text: Ethenia and Leyten fought at Narak under Sigzil. When Leyten tried to fight Moash, Moash, who could see spren through his crystal spikes, killed Ethenia with an anti-Stormlight knife and then stabbed Leyten with it.

personality.text: Syl describes Ethenia as having a very mathematical mind, and calls her a bore.
